perche: Z-C21.10, finding N61. verifica_geometria_corpo with «corpo_uid» filters the bodies of GetBodies2 down to the one asked for, and then judged what was left: one body, so «Un solo corpo solido, chiuso e senza difetti: come geometria si puo' esportare.» That sentence is about the PART, and on a part of two bodies it is false: an STL of it is two separate shells (see `due_corpi_non_si_esportano`). IPartDoc~GetBodies2.html: «false gets all of the bodies in the part» -- the count was there before the filter, and the verdict did not use it.
il_difetto_che_questo_caso_prende: Step 3 asks for ONE body of a part of TWO. The verdict must speak for that body and say how many the part has: «giudizio» names the body, says «only» and «the part has 2 bodies», and does not say «Un solo corpo»; «bodies_in_part» is 2 and «verdict_about» names the body. On library 0.140.0 the first expectation of step 3 is RED: the sentence is «Un solo corpo solido, chiuso e senza difetti: come geometria si puo' esportare.». Step 4 is the same part without «corpo_uid»: the verdict on the part, unchanged.
i_numeri: Block 100 x 100 x 20 = 200000 mm3. sposta_corpi copies it 600 mm along z: 2 bodies, 400000 mm3 (as in `due_corpi_non_si_esportano`). bodies_in_part = 2 with or without «corpo_uid»; corpi_totali = 1 with it (the bodies looked at), 2 without.
